query:
SELECT
            id          as "id: Id",
            sub         as "sub: Sub",
            email       as "email?: Email",
            name        as "name?: Name",
            created_at  as "created_at: CreatedAt"
        FROM users
        ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN ?2 = 'ascending' THEN
                    CASE ?1
                        WHEN 'id' THEN id
                        WHEN 'sub' THEN sub
                        WHEN 'email' THEN email
                        WHEN 'name' THEN name
                        WHEN 'created_at' THEN created_at
                    END
                END ASC NULLS LAST,
            CASE
                WHEN ?2 = 'descending' THEN
                    CASE ?1
                        WHEN 'id' THEN id
                        WHEN 'sub' THEN sub
                        WHEN 'email' THEN email
                        WHEN 'name' THEN name
                        WHEN 'created_at' THEN created_at
                    END
            END DESC NULLS LAST,
            -- keeps paging deterministic when the sort key ties
            id ASC
        LIMIT ?3 OFFSET ?4
